weather_report:
As the morning sun casts its warm glow over Boston, the air feels alive, buzzing with the promise of a sweltering day ahead. With the temperature flirting with the low nineties, one can sense a gentle whisper of heat rising, a preview of the heat index which nudges the boundaries of comfort. The sky is a pristine canvas, painted in deep blues, unmarred by clouds or fog, inviting you outdoors to breathe in the vivacious summer essence. Though tonight brings a slight possibility of rain, for now, the environment beckons with a somewhat sticky warmth, hinting at impending humidity that might surprise those unprepared. 

For those venturing out today, dressing lightly is essential—think airy fabrics to capture any breath of wind that may come. A comfortable pair of shorts or a breezy sundress can help keep that inner coolness alive. Perhaps a gentle stroll along the Esplanade or a lazy afternoon in one of Boston’s many parks, surrounded by friends or a good book, would lift your spirit amidst the bustling warmth. As the day unfolds, keeping hydrated will be key to navigating this hidden intensity of summer—revel in it, enjoy it, but be prepared for those whispers of thunderstorms come dawn.
